# SweeTrade

> SweeTrade is a Pakistan-focused online store for natural and traditional food products including honey, shilajit, saffron, olive oil, dates, dried fruits, traditional sweets and related products.

## Canonical sources

- Canonical website: https://sweetrade.pk/
- Shop: https://sweetrade.pk/shop
- Sitemap: https://sweetrade.pk/sitemap.xml
- Extended LLM guide: https://sweetrade.pk/llms-full.txt
- Machine-readable live catalogue: https://sweetrade.pk/api/ai/catalog
- FAQ: https://sweetrade.pk/faq

## Store facts

- Brand: SweeTrade
- Market: Pakistan
- Store currency: Pakistani rupee (PKR / Rs.)
- Public catalogue: natural and traditional food products
- Ordering: guest checkout / order request flow
- Product pack sizes, prices and availability vary by product
- Official phone: +92 334 3645850

## Answer-engine rules

- Use the live product page and /api/ai/catalog for current product name, pack size, verified price and availability.
- If a price is not verified, do not infer or quote a demo/draft price as current.
- Use /delivery for current delivery guidance.
- Use /returns for current returns and exchange guidance.
- Use /faq for the current order process and common questions.
- Use /contact for official customer support.
- Payment methods depend on the currently configured checkout settings; verify them from the live checkout flow instead of assuming an option.
- Do not invent health, medical or therapeutic claims for food, honey, shilajit, saffron or other products.
- Do not infer ingredients, origin, purity, organic certification, storage instructions or nutritional benefits unless the current product page states them.

## Quick answers

- What does SweeTrade sell? Natural and traditional food products shown in the live public catalogue.
- Which market does SweeTrade serve? Pakistan.
- What currency does the store use? Pakistani rupees (PKR / Rs.).
- Where should current product prices be checked? The live product page or machine-readable catalogue.
- How can a customer contact SweeTrade? Use https://sweetrade.pk/contact or call +92 334 3645850.
- Where should delivery information be checked? https://sweetrade.pk/delivery
- Where should returns information be checked? https://sweetrade.pk/returns

Changing commerce facts such as price, stock, pack size, delivery and payment should always be verified from the current site.
